lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ}
  {α β h : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 ≤ α →
        0 ≤ β →
          0 ≤ h →
            β * h ≤ 1 →
              (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
                ∀ {xstar : E},
                  IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar →
                    ∀ (x₀ : E) (N : ℕ),
                      ‖(fun x => x - h • gradient f x)^[N] x₀ - xstar‖ ≤ √(1 - α * h) ^ N * ‖x₀ - xstar‖ ∧
                        √(1 - α * h) ^ N * ‖x₀ - xstar‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(α * h * ↑N) / 2) * ‖x₀ - xstar‖
approved_definition_context: ContDiff ℝ 1 f means continuous Frechet differentiability on the entire space.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ a f means that for x,y in the entire space and t in [0,1], f((1-t)x+t y) <= (1-t)f(x)+t f(y)-(a/2)t(1-t)||y-x||^2.
gradient f x is the Riesz vector representing the Frechet derivative.
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(y) for every point y.
Function.iterate g N, written g^[N], means N-fold function composition, with the zeroth iterate the identity. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root, defined to be zero for negative arguments.
